site.name: Sewa Track
home.title: Where are ward requests delayed?
home.subtitle: Apply for ward recommendation letters, track them with a code, and see where requests are overdue against the citizen charter, across all 753 local levels.
home.demoData: Demo data, generated for this portfolio project.
home.step1: Check the documents and the demo fee for your letter.
home.step2: Apply online and keep your tracking code.
home.step3: Follow every step without visiting the office.
home.mostOverdue: Districts with the most overdue requests
home.mapSoon: The interactive district map is added once a boundary file that follows Nepal's official 2020 map is verified.
services.title: Ward recommendation services
services.intro: Know the documents, fee and promised time before you visit.
services.demoValues: Demo values, based on public citizen charters; may be outdated.
common.error: Could not load this. Please try again.
footer.about: Sewa Track is an open-source demo of a national ward service tracker.
track.title: Track your request
track.intro: Enter the tracking code you received when you applied. No login needed.
track.label: Tracking code
track.hint: Letters O, I and L are read as 0 and 1.
track.invalid: The code should look like ST-7K3QX9M2PD.
track.notFound: No request found with this code. Check it and try again.
track.tooMany: Too many lookups. Please wait a minute and try again.
track.privacy: Shown publicly: status and dates only. No names, IDs or notes.
login.title: Log in
login.demoIntro: One click, fake accounts only. There is no sign-up: this demo never collects real phone numbers.
login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
common.forbidden: You don't have access to this page or request.
login.expired: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
track.helpButton: Where do I find my code?
track.helpBody: You get a tracking code like ST-7K3QX9M2PD when you submit a request. It is shown on screen right after you apply and in “My requests”. Anyone with the code can see the status, but never your name or documents.
citizen.myIntro: Every request you have submitted, newest first.
citizen.empty: You haven't applied for anything yet.
apply.title: Apply for a ward letter
apply.intro: Fill in the form. You'll get a tracking code right away.
apply.purposeHint: Why do you need this letter? 10 to 500 characters.
apply.name: Applicant name
apply.nidHint: Format DEMO-1234567. Never enter a real citizenship number.
apply.consent: I understand this is a demo and I am not entering real information.
apply.successBody: Keep this tracking code. You can follow your request with it, even without logging in.
detail.needsDocsTitle: The ward asked for more documents
detail.cancelBody: The ward will stop working on it. This cannot be undone.
detail.conflict: This request was updated by someone else. The page now shows the latest version; please check and try again.
apply.err.wardId: Choose your province, district, palika and ward.
apply.err.name: Enter the applicant's name (2 to 100 characters).
apply.err.nid: Use a demo ID like DEMO-1234567.
apply.err.consent: Please confirm this is a demo.
